title: Level one Fourier expansion
statement: Let $f$ be a function from the $n$-dimensional sign cube to $\{-1,1\}$, and suppose the total Fourier weight of its level-one coefficients is $1$. Then at every input $x$, its real-valued form satisfies $f(x)=\sum_{i=1}^n \widehat f(\{i\})x_i$, where $\widehat f(\{i\})$ is the Fourier coefficient indexed by the singleton coordinate $i$.
hypotheses_covered: The level-one Fourier weight of the real-valued form of $f$ equals $1$
$x$ is an input in the $n$-dimensional sign cube
